title: Dónde publicar y eventos dentro del proyecto
brief: Let students and teachers of Colegio Mayor del Cauca see ALL the journal information (affinity ring and «¿Por qué X %?», quartile/Publindex, SJR, H index, weeks to publish, templates, filters, list/table, compare up to 3) and ALL the event information (affinity ranking, convocatoria vs asistir, dates and deadlines, location, filters, compare, save, calendar) inside the project detail page, without going to /donde-publicar or /eventos. The standalone pages stay unchanged and every embedded section offers an «Abrir en la página completa» escape hatch for the general view. Content is real: project 1 «Sistema de Monitoreo Agrícola Distribuido con MQTT» with its 60 matched journals and 25 current events, using the app's own affinity logic. Each artboard has a «Maqueta» bar (not part of the product) to jump to states and preview a 390 px mobile frame.

artboards.title: Pestañas dentro del proyecto
artboards.tradeoff: Journals and events keep the full-fidelity tools of the standalone pages in their own tab, each tab remembers its state and the URL can point at it; gives up seeing journals and events (or the technical sheet) at the same time, and needs the project page widened from max-w-5xl to max-w-7xl to fit the table

artboards.title: Panel lateral sobre el proyecto
artboards.tradeoff: The project stays visible behind and the page layout does not change; gives up width and simplicity: the table needs «Ampliar» (which turns the panel into a modal), the compare tray competes for a 760 px column, and it adds a new overlay surface with its own focus and URL state to maintain

artboards.title: Página continua con navegación fija
artboards.tradeoff: Best for browsing: top 3 of each list and a live summary bar are visible with no click, and «ver todas» expands in place with filters and compare; gives up a predictable page length (expanded sections push the technical sheet far down) and keeps about 100 px of sticky navigation on screen
